title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the mustard flyer, rebuilt as a living site. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Mustard Flyer, Alive
options.lineage: Makalipie’s own printed menu flyer and smiley pie-crust badge
options.thesis: The site is the flyer you can order from: mustard field, real pie cutouts, and a window you can miss.
options.viewport: A full-bleed mustard sheet: smiley badge top-right, slogan as the display line, three real pie cutouts with oval prices, a named hours threshold (open / Buko weekend / market / closed), and a stepped tab (Menu · Visit · Order) whose current tab is the yellow board. Primary action: send the Instagram DM.
options.risk: If the pies stay small and the yellow is timid, it reads as the old PDF posted online.

raised.raise: Kiosk as a furnished place: the first viewport is a real pie counter built from Makalipie photography, not a stock kitchen.
Stepped tab rail: Menu, Visit, and Order are fore-edge tabs; the current tab is the mustard board, and one type size does the work.
Availability is a threshold: Buko Friday–Sunday and Sunday Market until 3PM can be missed, marked as a committed before/after, not a badge.
Named time phases bound to Asia/Manila: Closed, Kiosk open, Buko window, Sunday Market — labeled in words, never color alone.

options.label: Laminated Photo Menu
options.lineage: Cebu food-court and Carbon Market laminated photo menus
options.thesis: You point at a real pie under plastic, read the oval price, and order — the catalog is the proof.
options.viewport: A wall of Makalipie’s real tart photos under laminate, oval prices stuck on each, Buko and Sunday savory called out as today’s cards, kiosk hours on a strip, Instagram DM as the order ticket at the bottom.
options.risk: This is also the direction most bakery sites land on: photos plus prices on a board.

options.label: Pie Select Rail
options.thesis: Flavors string along a perforated rail; Buko is the flagged frame, Sunday savory hangs on a pin, an order is a committed cut.
options.viewport: A black bench with a mustard-orange rail of real pie frames; the Buko frame wears a folded flag Fri–Sun, sold-out slices take a grease cross, Sunday curry hangs below on pins, and Send DM commits the cut.
options.case: Holds product clarity: availability is a mark on a rail, not a paragraph. Loses audience identification: Cebu merienda is not a cutting room.
options.risk: Reads as a film tool wearing pie photos unless every mark maps to a real window.

options.label: Kiosk Viewfinder
options.thesis: The pie stays full-bleed; hours, Buko window, and the DM sit as OSD in the corners, never on top of the filling.
options.viewport: One full-bleed Makalipie tart; corner brackets on the slice, a tape-counter of kiosk hours, REC when open, zebra over sold-out flavors, W–T zoom from Streetscape to crust, Send DM as the shutter.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the pie is unmissable and status lives in the HUD. Loses audience identification: it reads as camera gear, not a Cebuana kiosk.
options.risk: The OSD can steal the crust, or the black letterbox can make a warm bakery feel like a camera shop.

options.label: Kiosk Minihompy
options.thesis: Makalipie as a furnishable isometric kiosk room.
options.viewport: A tiny Streetscape kiosk you decorate, with a visitor counter and a pie on the counter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Cebu customers came to secure a pie, not furnish a room.
options.kept: Kiosk as a furnished place — the first viewport is a real counter of pies, not stock.

options.label: Acetate Order Manual
options.thesis: Menu, Visit, and Order as punched acetate leaves over a chrome-yellow board.
options.viewport: An open manual: yellow divider, acetate price leaf, tab rail down the fore edge.
options.risk: Reads as software docs, not merienda.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reference manual is not how Cebu finds a kiosk pie.
options.kept: Stepped tab rail — current section is the mustard board; one type size does the work.

options.label: Buko Horizon
options.thesis: Availability as matter crossing an irreversible threshold.
options.viewport: A dark disk of pies with Buko vanishing at a gold horizon when Friday ends.
options.risk: Cosmic grammar swallows a Banilad kiosk.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody looking for Streetscape identifies with a black hole.
options.kept: Availability as a threshold — Buko and Sunday Market can be missed.

options.label: Merienda Cyclorama
options.thesis: The page lights from closed night through opening to full kiosk day.
options.viewport: A curved wash behind the pies that shifts with real Manila time.
options.case: Fuses poorly: theater lighting is not a Cebuana bakery’s home.
options.kept: Named time phases bound to real hours, labeled in words.

canonCard.label: Warm bakery landing
canonCard.thesis: Cream ground, display serif, pastry hero, dual CTAs — what bakery marketing sites always ship.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero: tagline and Order now beside a tart photograph, then a card grid of flavors.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other bakery site, including the current one.
